notes: Redeployed to change on-chain behaviour: cancel() now reverts once any participant has paid (PaymentsAlreadyStarted), instead of the old 'only before withdrawal' rule. claimRefund() and the whole refund mechanism were removed since cancellation and a nonzero amountPaid can no longer coexist.

Splits created against the previous address (0x61966a27d3a308A225ae2Faa20382B2A5Fa57A3E) keep the old cancel-any-time-before-withdrawal behaviour forever — that bytecode is immutable and this deployment does not migrate them.
Deployer is a throwaway burner funded from a faucet; it holds no privileges on the contract (owner/treasury is set to 0x6B661614e175A9Eb166F08F8a8F46abD83C06584 directly).
Basescan verification still pending — no BASESCAN_API_KEY available at deploy time.

Deployed runtime bytecode matches a local `forge build` exactly once the immutable `token` address is injected into its slots; contract size is 13,136 bytes (down from the prior deployment, since claimRefund and its supporting code were removed).
